description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Revoke the Electricity Generation Licenses
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notice issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under Section 20(2) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009. It concerns the intention to revoke electricity generation licenses from specific companies due to amalgamation, which falls under regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements. This does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
